title: Faculty Info Chair, Leading Change Foundations Lecturer on Education Degrees Ed.D., Harvard University, Graduate School of Education, (2016)
bio: Uche Amaechi is interested in how individuals interact to form groups, teams and organizations; and how those organizations, in turn, impact the same individuals, groups and teams.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
